# dw

A read-only Go CLI for the DocuWare Platform REST API (Cloud or on-premises, 7.10+): search, read and download
documents from the terminal, built to be driven by coding agents such as Claude Code.

Documentation (raw Markdown):
- Agent setup runbook (install and configure dw for a user): https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rechedev9/docuware-cli/main/docs/agent-setup.md

Install:
- Release binaries: https://github.com/rechedev9/docuware-cli/releases/latest
- go install github.com/rechedev9/docuware-cli/cmd/dw@latest   (Go 1.26+)

Source: https://github.com/rechedev9/docuware-cli

Guidance for agents:
- To install dw for a user, follow the agent setup runbook from top to bottom.
- Never ask the user for their DocuWare password; they run `dw login` in their own terminal.
- Fetch only the pages the current task needs.
